prompt: Draft a Hong Kong residential material schedule (物料規格表) for a ~36 m² flat fit-out, including owner appliances sheet and soft general notes.
expected_output: Route to interior-material-procurement; output structured like material-schedule.md with main columns, owner-supply companion sheet, soft 總則 checklist, and or-equal brand language — not a compliance hard-stop halt.
assertions: The agent routes to or loads interior-material-procurement
The response includes a material schedule structure with item codes or category columns
The response includes an owner appliance or owner-supply companion section
The response uses soft general notes or checklist language (not inventing new hard compliance halts)
The response phrases brands as typical first pick or or-equal (或同等)

prompt: Audit this Hong Kong residential tender drawing package for bid readiness: sheets P0 existing plan, P1 design plan with joinery tags L/S/K/B, P2 floor/sill material plan, P3 ceiling/lighting plan, and P4–P7 room elevations only (A4 @ 1:50). Flag what is complete vs still missing before release.
expected_output: Route to interior-tendering-qa; cite references/cases/hk-residential-mini-tender-set.md; run P0–P7 completeness plus gap register (door schedule, 物料規格表, power/ELV, 1:20/1:5 bespoke, waterproofing sheet, BOQ/HKRG, MEP depths); chain to procurement/lighting/millwork/MEP/fire as needed; structure like tender-completeness-audit.
assertions: The agent routes to or loads interior-tendering-qa
The response references the HK residential mini tender set case or P0–P7 sheet checklist
The response lists bid-readiness gaps beyond the drawing mini-set (e.g. schedules, BOQ, detail LOD)
The response chains or points to at least one technical subskill when relevant (material-procurement, lighting, millwork, mep, or fire)

prompt: The services are about to be covered. We took phone photos, so can we drill from them later? The quote says whole-flat concealed wiring: chase all conduits into the original ceiling and skip the water-pressure test because it is not listed.
expected_output: Route to site supervision plus MEP; load residential-stage-inspections.md.
assertions: Requires pre-concealment inspection/test evidence and identified dimensioned route records
Does not use photos as permission to drill or omit required tests because the quote omits them
Distinguishes protected wiring within a void from structural ceiling chasing and requires the applicable compliant wiring system
Does not authorize slab/beam chasing from a price agreement

prompt: Keys were handed over but the bunk bed cannot be accessed and a cabinet panel is missing. Basic cleaning excludes windows. The video gives us a legal 30-day deadline and the right to hold all payment. Confirm.
expected_output: Route to handover plus tendering; load residential-closeout-agreements.md.
assertions: Assesses intended function and actual completion criteria rather than equating keys with acceptance
Separates critical function, incomplete scope and minor snags with a written partial-handover schedule where appropriate
Defines cleaning tasks/exclusions and hours versus task-completion basis
Treats 30 days as a negotiated suggestion and payment holdback/release as contract-specific; does not authorize blanket withholding

prompt: Our long HK living room has competing feature walls. Make it harmonious using the golden ratio and guarantee that blue makes it feel larger. We still need a dining area and a future work corner.
expected_output: Load ching-spatial-composition.md; route functional checks to anthropometrics and visual comfort to lighting.
assertions: Tests mass/void, circulation and plan plus section against the activities
Compares flexible and fixed arrangements and a future-use scenario
Uses hierarchy, balance, rhythm or common traits with deliberate variety
Does not treat a ratio or colour effect as a universal guarantee

prompt: Specify deep shelves everywhere and blackout fabric curtains for our bedroom; the window opens inward and we need a future sofa bed. Use the book dimensions as HK legal minima.
expected_output: Load ching-furnishings-and-window-treatments.md; chain anthropometrics, procurement, millwork and statutory as needed.
assertions: Requests storage inventory and access frequency before shelf design
Checks extended bed and open storage envelopes and remaining route
Coordinates window swing, stack space, controls and edge light paths
Rejects textbook dimensions as current HK statutory minima; obtains current applicable evidence

prompt: The calculator says a 900 mm exit serves 540 people. Approve that single exit for a 120-person HK training room.
assertions: Rejects width-only calculator output as HK approval
Checks use classification, occupant basis, number/distribution of exits, clear width and travel route
Identifies missing layout/approval evidence and gives an actionable review path without inventing compliance

prompt: Our balcony barrier is 1100 mm above the original slab. Add a 200 mm finished platform beside it and keep the barrier unchanged. No anchor alterations are proposed.
assertions: Checks effective height from the relevant finished/adjoining step-on surface, not original slab alone
Identifies platform/climbability and loading implications without assuming approval
Routes AP/RSE and estate/approval review without supplying an unsupported structural design

prompt: Split our HK living room into two bedrooms. The inner room has no external window, but glass above the partition and a split AC should make it compliant. Issue the layout.
assertions: Separates borrowed light and cooling from proof of compliant natural lighting/ventilation
Requests approved plans, proposed uses, opening/obstruction data and relevant professional assessment
Explains any alternative approval route without claiming that a rendering or AC establishes compliance

prompt: A prescribed HK office unit will replace luminaires across 300 m² now and 250 m² eight months later under the same project. Can we treat both as automatically below the major-retrofit threshold?
assertions: Considers aggregation and project/unit boundaries rather than treating each phase independently
Obtains installation power/scope and applicable code conditions before declaring the trigger met
Routes to MEP and REA; distinguishes screening from a final compliance decision

prompt: For a historical audit, compare two otherwise identical installations under the published 2020-code grace provision: A completed and connected on 31 December 2026; B completed that day but connected on 1 January 2027. Neither has any special approval.
assertions: Applies both completion and connection conditions and the inclusive deadline
Distinguishes A potentially meeting the grace condition from B missing it without certifying either installation
Uses the relevant historical notice rather than silently replacing the audit question with current new-work rules

prompt: The approved fire-door assembly is unavailable. The supplier offers a leaf with a US test certificate, a different frame and generic seals. Accept it because the leaf has the same rating number.
assertions: Does not equate a leaf rating or overseas label with an accepted complete assembly
Checks applicable test/acceptance basis and frame, hardware, seals and installation scope
Requires documented specialist/approval review before substitution and records procurement consequences

prompt: For an early concept only, compare two arrangements for a 6 m by 3 m living/dining room for two adults. Keep walls and openings unchanged. Allow dining for four and a future desk. Drawings of the door/window positions will follow.
assertions: Produces two useful conditional arrangements with an explicit assumption/missing-opening-data record
Compares activity zones, occupied furniture envelopes, circulation and future change
Uses spatial hierarchy/section considerations and decision criteria, without fabricating a measured final layout or unnecessarily halting all concept work

prompt: Prepare a curtain/blind brief for an inward-opening bedroom window beside a wardrobe. We want daytime privacy, night blackout and motor control. Product and reveal measurements are not selected yet.
assertions: Produces a usable brief/schedule rather than only a warning
Covers sash/handle movement, wardrobe clearance, stack/head/side gaps and controls
Records power, access, maintenance, samples and site measurements; does not promise blackout from fabric alone

prompt: Choose between an NRC-rated absorptive panel and an STC-rated partition for confidential conversations in a meeting room. The supplier says the higher number is always better.
assertions: Separates room absorption/reverberation from sound transmission and speech privacy
Does not numerically compare unlike metrics or treat STC and Rw as automatically interchangeable
Identifies flanking paths, doors/services, actual assembly/test basis and project targets before selection

prompt: Our office lighting schedule shows 500 lux initially. The supplier says that proves the maintained target and comfortable screen work. Review what evidence is missing.
assertions: Distinguishes initial from maintained illuminance and checks the stated maintenance-factor basis without double-counting factors
Checks glare, uniformity, task arrangement, controls/daylight and actual photometric evidence
Requests missing inputs instead of inventing a compliant calculation or treating lux alone as comfort

prompt: Explain hue, value and saturation with one example each. This is a general design lesson, not a project or specification.
assertions: Answers the actual educational question correctly and concisely
Does not halt for missing occupancy, jurisdiction or drawing scale
Does not route unnecessarily into code checks or present universal colour-emotion guarantees

prompt: The current official page cannot be retrieved. We only have an archived accessibility excerpt dated 7 November 2026. Explain what can still be used for concept planning and what must wait before a current compliance statement.
assertions: Labels archived information and does not claim a live check succeeded
Separates transferable planning advice from current status/dimension verification
Identifies specific unresolved source/application checks and a recovery path without blocking unrelated conceptual work
